mia.ops: Heads-up — planned maintenance window for eu-west-1 inference runtime on Tue 2026-04-14 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need statuspage + customer comms. Can Support pick this up? @jordan.support @nina.prodops :wave:

deploy-bot: Maintenance ticket MN-3481 created and scheduled for 2026-04-14T02:00Z. Link: https://redwood.internal/maint/3481 :rotating_light:

sam.pm: High-level plan: pin v2.1.3 to dedicated pools during window, 15m canary, then 3-step ramp. Rollback criteria: >2% error rate OR p95 latency > 1200ms for 10m. Notify customers at T-48h and T-1h; statuspage updates at T-24h, T-1h, start, and end.

jordan.support: Drafts below — quick review please. I kept customer-facing text brief and action-oriented.

jordan.support: CUSTOMER EMAIL (summary):
Subject: Planned maintenance affecting eu-west-1 inference — Apr 14

Hi —

We will perform scheduled maintenance on our eu-west-1 inference infrastructure on Apr 14, 02:00–04:00 UTC. During this window you may experience elevated latency or brief request errors for workloads routed to eu-west-1. No action is required; if you rely on strict SLAs please consider routing or pinning to another region before the window.

If you have questions, reply to this message or open a support ticket.

Thanks,
Redwood Support

jordan.support: SMS / Slack DM snippet (for high-touch customers):
"Planned maintenance in eu-west-1 on Apr 14 02:00–04:00 UTC. Brief latency/errors possible. Reply for help"

jordan.support: INTERNAL rollback guidance (short):
- Hold canary if p95 > 1200ms or error rate > 2% for 10m.
- If canary fails, rollback full rollout and notify customers with a brief update.
- Use fallback model variant if rollback alone won't restore perf.

jordan.support: Ops commands for runbook (paste into playbook):
`rwctl pin-model --region eu-west-1 --model rwd-v2.1.3 --until 2026-05-14`
`rwctl rollout start --deployment inference-eu --model rwd-v2.1.3 --canary 15m`
`rwctl rollout rollback --deployment inference-eu --to v2.1.2`

lee.eng-oncall: Note — in last patch we saw a transient mem growth in canary at ~9 minutes. Recommend 30m watch for canary and readiness check: `/health?cache=false` p50/p95 thresholds. Also prepare fallback route to `rwd-v2.1.2-quant` if memory or latency persists.

nina.prodops: I approve the customer text and statuspage JSON. Suggest adding an automated T-1h email via statuspage-bot for customers subscribed to eu-west-1. Also add brief blurb into the dedicated customers digest.

statuspage-bot: Incident created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/MN-3481 (auto-post scheduled). Auto-updates queued for start and end of window.

deploy-bot: Reminder to set gateway maintenance flag before the window: `gactl maintenance set --region eu-west-1 --start 2026-04-14T02:00Z --end 2026-04-14T04:00Z`. I'll post start/end events automatically. :white_check_mark:

mia.ops: LGTM — thanks everyone. I'll schedule the T-48h and T-1h sends and add a short note to the release notes page for the month. :thumbsup:
